story.title: Deafening Silence
story.blurb: Zion Daybreaker and Naomi, who grew up together, move from a treehouse promise of a better life to a bitter argument over what they owe the people who hurt them.

lines.text: As I looked over the destruction of those who forsook me, I could not help but wonder if things could have been different. It was not ambition that brought us here. There was not an objective that pushed these people to their end. This outcome was brought about from pure evil.
